2. Start & End Date

Start Date (Experiment Creation): [[EXPERIMENT_DATE]]

End Date (Report Date): [[REPORT_DATE]]

3. Methods

Overview of Automated Workflow

  1. Manual Sample Loading
    • The workflow starts with a manual pause step prompting the user with the message: "Manually fill sample loop".
    • The sample loop is filled with the prepared sample according to the experimental plan before continuing the automated run.
  2. ÄKTA Pure Chromatography Run
    • The ÄKTA Pure system executes a predefined protocol with online monitoring of UV (uv1) and conductivity (cond) signals.
    • Data are recorded with a sample time of 1 second for all monitored signals.
Run Parameters
Parameter Value / Placeholder Description
Process ID [[PROCESS_ID]] Identifier of the automated chromatography process.
Equilibration Duration [[EQUILIBRATION_DURATION]] Total time for column equilibration before loading.
Equilibration Flow Rate [[EQUILIBRATION_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate used during the equilibration phase.
Load/Inject Duration [[LOAD_INJECT_DURATION]] Duration of the sample loading/injection step.
Load/Inject Flow Rate [[LOAD_INJECT_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during the loading/injection phase.
Elution Gradient Duration [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_DURATION]] Duration of the gradient elution phase.
Elution Gradient Start (% B) [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_START]] Starting modifier/buffer B percentage at the beginning of the gradient.
Elution Gradient End (% B) [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_END]] Final modifier/buffer B percentage at the end of the gradient.
CIP Duration [[CIP_DURATION]] Duration of the main cleaning-in-place (CIP) phase.
CIP 2 Hold Duration [[CIP_2_HOLD_DURATION]] Hold time during the second CIP step.
CIP 3 Duration [[CIP_3_DURATION]] Duration of the third CIP step.
CIP 4 Duration [[CIP_4_DURATION]] Duration of the fourth CIP step.
CIP 5 Duration [[CIP_5_DURATION]] Duration of the fifth CIP step.
Wash Duration [[WASH_DURATION]] Total time for column washing steps.
Wash Flow Rate [[WASH_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate applied during wash phases.
